key_insight: A correlation-aware quantum feature map can inject classical feature dependencies into quantum encoding to produce more discriminative representations for variational quantum classification.
engineering_relevance: This suggests a practical way to improve quantum ML pipelines by using feature correlation structure to guide circuit design rather than relying on fixed, generic encodings.
method: Compute feature dependencies with Pearson, Spearman, Kendall Tau, Mutual Information, and Distance Correlation.
Select relationships above a threshold and encode them using controlled quantum gates.
Feed the resulting feature map into a variational quantum classifier.
evidence_signal: The method was evaluated on breast cancer diagnosis, credit default prediction, and student placement classification, and the Spearman and Kendall Tau variants achieved the best performance in simulation.
watch_item: Threshold choice and added controlled-gate complexity may increase circuit depth and sensitivity to noise on real quantum hardware.
paper_title: A Correlation Aware Quantum Feature Map for Variational Quantum Classification
